slides.caption: Boltz-2 2.2.1 on A100, three seeds per prediction, three independent runs. A sabotaged system cannot bind as deposited, so every sabotaged pose should be rejected.

slides.title: CDK2: the ligand stays, the contacts go
slides.subtitle: 1B38 chain A, Boltz-2 medoid boltz2/seed3/sample0, 13 contacts cut to glycine
slides.caption: Contacts 5 of 9 then 1 of 9; ipTM 0.975 then 0.947.
slides.notes: One camera, proteins superposed; red marks the residues cut to glycine. Confidence barely moves (0.975 to 0.947) and PoseBusters still passes 20 of 20. The interactions are what collapse, and that is what the fact file reports.

slides.caption: Contact recovery falls on every target. Cross-executor RMSD rises on CDK2 and MEK1 and falls on glucose dehydrogenase, where both tools were already far apart.
